title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 7: the sermon at the temple gate, the den of robbers, Shiloh, and the valley of Topheth.

questions.text: Where was Jeremiah told to stand and proclaim this word?
questions.explanation: He was told, "Stand in the gate of Yahweh's house, and proclaim this word there."

answers.text: On the wall of Jerusalem
In the king's palace
In the gate of the city of David
In the gate of Yahweh's house

questions.text: Which lying words were the people told not to trust in?
questions.explanation: They were told, "Don't trust in lying words, saying, 'Yahweh's temple, Yahweh's temple, Yahweh's temple, are these.'"

answers.text: "Peace and safety will be ours forever and ever"
"Yahweh's temple, Yahweh's temple, Yahweh's temple, are these"
"The ark of the covenant of Yahweh is with us"
"The throne of David will stand firm forever"

questions.text: Whom were the people told not to oppress?
questions.explanation: They were told not to oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and not to shed innocent blood in this place.

answers.text: The priests and the Levites in the temple
The servants and the hired workers
The foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow
The poor, the sick and the blind

questions.text: What did Yahweh say the house called by his name had become in their eyes?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asked, "Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it."

answers.text: A den of robbers
A house of merchandise
A high place of Baal
A hall for the kings

questions.text: To which place were the people told to go and see what Yahweh did for the wickedness of Israel?
questions.explanation: They were told, "go now to my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it."

answers.text: Bethel
Samaria
Gilgal
Shiloh

questions.text: What was Jeremiah told not to do for this people?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "don't pray for this people. Don't lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me; for I will not hear you."

answers.text: Not to eat or drink among them
Not to pray or make intercession for them
Not to prophesy in the temple again
Not to marry or have children among them

questions.text: For whom did the women knead dough to make cakes?
questions.explanation: The children gather wood, the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough to make cakes to the queen of the sky.

answers.text: The queen of the sky
Baal
The host of heaven
The gods of Egypt

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he commanded the fathers when he brought them out of Egypt?
questions.explanation: He did not speak concerning burnt offerings, but commanded, "Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people."

answers.text: To offer burnt offerings every morning and every evening
To build him a great house of cedar in Jerusalem
"Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people"
To keep the feast of the Passover every year in its season

questions.text: What was done at the high places of Topheth in the valley of the son of Hinnom?
questions.explanation: They built the high places of Topheth to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which Yahweh did not command.

answers.text: They offered incense to the queen of the sky
They burned their sons and daughters in the fire
They buried the kings of Judah
They sacrificed bulls to Baal

questions.text: What will the valley of the son of Hinnom be called in the days to come?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says it will no more be called Topheth or the valley of the son of Hinnom, but "The valley of Slaughter," for they will bury in Topheth until there is no place left.

answers.text: "The valley of Bones"
"The valley of Weeping"
"The valley of Fire"
"The valley of Slaughter"
